why_ai: Tier-1 triage is being absorbed by AI SOC platforms; adversarial incidents keep senior analysts needed.
why_clarity: Playbooks govern thousands of repeat alerts, but many dispositions are never confirmed true or false.
why_digital: Logs and alerts in, monitoring and response delivered remotely from a SOC.

why_ai: Most alerts are pattern-recognisable false positives that confidence-scored automation can close directly.
why_clarity: Each alert is closed or escalated by playbook, thousands per day, though ground truth lags.
why_digital: SIEM alerts in, dispositions out, entirely inside security platforms.

why_ai: Adversarial, novel breach investigations drive litigation and notification; insurers and counsel call trusted firms.
why_clarity: Every breach differs, and root cause findings are rarely objectively confirmed.
why_digital: Forensic images and logs analysed on screens; engagements come through insurer panels and counsel.

why_ai: Statutory authority, binding directives and intelligence access belong to a federal agency, not software.
why_clarity: Catalogue entries recur, but campaign analysis and advisories resolve slowly and contestably.
why_digital: Incident reports in, advisories out online; no commercial buyer chooses the agency.

why_ai: Deterministic requirement-to-evidence mapping is exactly what AI-native GRC software already automates.
why_clarity: Each control maps to specific logs or screenshots for a period, instantly checkable.
why_digital: Platform exports in, evidence binders out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Well-defined NCUA and FFIEC requirements automate, but credit unions buy security from trusted regional providers.

why_digital: Monitoring delivered remotely; credit unions buy through leagues, conferences and relationships.

why_ai: Detection knowledge is largely published openly and AI can write rules against new techniques.
why_clarity: Rules either fire on emulated techniques or not, mapped to a shared framework.
why_digital: Threat research in, rule libraries out, sold online globally.

why_ai: HIPAA breach determinations carry legal consequences, though PHI triage follows structured, automatable rules.
why_clarity: The four-factor breach risk assessment gives a structured, repeatable decision.
why_digital: Healthcare logs monitored remotely; services sold to health systems through practice leads.

why_ai: Safety consequences force human verification before acting on legacy OT networks.
why_clarity: Protocol-specific patterns help, but each plant's OT environment is idiosyncratic.
why_digital: Plant sensors feed remote monitoring; industrial clients buy after site-based trust building.

why_ai: Predictable district networks suit template monitoring; districts buy from trusted local providers.
why_clarity: Template monitoring against CIPA and FERPA requirements repeats across districts.
why_digital: Remote monitoring service, bought through public procurement and local relationships.

why_ai: Neutral stewardship of the industry's shared vocabulary persists regardless of AI tooling.
why_clarity: Identifier assignment and technique mapping follow published rules at high volume.
why_digital: Disclosures in, taxonomies published freely online, funded by federal contract.

why_ai: Attackers adapt to detections, but cross-client telemetry lets AI write and tune much content.
why_clarity: Detections are testable against telemetry, but hunting finds novel activity case by case.
why_digital: Client telemetry in, detection code and research out, all on screens.

why_ai: Acquisition calls on security providers are high-stakes judgment made through founder relationships.
why_clarity: Diligence models are standard, but each deal is distinct and pays off years later.
why_digital: Financial models on screens; targets sourced and diligenced through meetings.

why_ai: Adversarial testing of novel client environments is required annually and signed by accountable testers.
why_clarity: Methodologies exist, but finding quality varies with each environment and tester.
why_digital: Client systems tested remotely; reports delivered digitally to buyers anywhere.

why_ai: Rural co-ops with legacy SCADA buy from regional providers they know, under NERC CIP mandates.
why_clarity: Small standardised networks allow template monitoring, with OT adding exceptions.
why_digital: Remote monitoring of legacy SCADA, sold face to face by regional MSSPs.

why_ai: Member-shared incident detail exists only because of trust arrangements built over years.
why_clarity: Alerting recurs with active campaigns, but analysis value is judged by members slowly.
why_digital: Threat data shared and analysed online; membership trust built through summits and meetings.

why_ai: Credential brand is the hiring signal, though AI pressures exam validity and blueprint relevance.
why_clarity: Psychometric methods are codified and item statistics give fast objective feedback.
why_digital: Exams developed on screens and delivered online or at proctored test centres.

why_ai: Longitudinal internet-scale observation joined to breach outcomes is a durable, contested data moat.
why_clarity: Millions of organisations rated by algorithm, but rating validity is disputed and breaches lag.
why_digital: Internet scans in, ratings and portfolio monitoring out, licensed online.

why_ai: Simple SMB networks suit fully automated security bundled into platforms; local MSP trust slows switching.
why_clarity: Highly standardised monitoring repeats across thousands of small, similar environments.
why_digital: Remote monitoring, sold to small businesses through their local MSP.

why_ai: A decade of criminal-forum collection access and adversarial attribution work cannot be regenerated by AI.
why_clarity: Finished intelligence recurs as subscriptions, but attribution accuracy is rarely confirmed.
why_digital: Forum and malware data in, finished intelligence out, sold globally online.

why_ai: Clients pay for a fractional security leader's judgment and accountability; documentation work automates.
why_clarity: Roadmaps and assessments follow frameworks, but programme success shows slowly.
why_digital: Assessments and documents produced on screens; board briefings sometimes in person.

why_ai: Platform telemetry across millions of hosts is unique, and adversary tracking is adversarial work.
why_clarity: Research and detections recur with each campaign, but attribution is judged slowly.
why_digital: Endpoint telemetry in, publications and intelligence out, entirely online.
